title: lobelia caerulea var. latidens
intro: Lobelia caerulea var. latidens, commonly known as Blue Lobelia, is a flowering plant species in the family Campanulaceae. This plant is used in herbal medicine to provide relief from respiratory issues such as bronchitis and asthma due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and expectorant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lobelia caerulea var. latidens include stimulating respiration, relieving spasms, and acting as a bronchodilator. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
